- When sentiment is positive (≥0.2), model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast peaks by 5–10%.
- Model consistently overpredicts early in the 30-day horizon, especially after recent spikes; apply a 3–5 day lag correction.
- After a price spike, model overshoots and fails to correct; dampen forecast slope downward by 10–15% for 3–5 days post-spike.
- Mean reversion is strong in 10–14 day horizon; if forecast exceeds 20% above recent 18-day average, reduce by 15–20%.
- If sentiment is flat (0.00) and forecast is high, model is overconfident; apply downward bias of 3–7% to avoid overfitting to recent highs.
